description: Keyword search of ONE model, the artworks: words of the title, the artist name and the description. Use it when you are looking for a work (a painting, a drawing, a sculpture). When the words may name an artist, a museum or an article instead, use search_fts, which searches the four models in one call; when you have a sentence or a paragraph and no name, use search_objects_semantically. Optional artist: only the works of that artist, the query words matched against ALL of them (artist_artworks_count says how many) - without query, his most popular works. To find out whether a half-remembered work is in the catalog, use find_artwork_in_catalog (one call) rather than many searches with title variants. Returns only good-confidence matches with pk, artist_name, title, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large artwork image, null when the artwork has no image) and relevance score.

artist.description: Optional artist name: search only his works.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Words from the artwork title, artist name and/or description (optional when artist is given).

name: search_artworks
title: Search artworks
